notes.title: Pre-Alpha
notes.content:
Development
Skyfall has now reached the 'pre-alpha' development stage! The game's back-end coding is ~30% completed!

Amazing progress for almost a year of development, yes I know.

Changes

 1 State Machine -> 2-3 State Machines per NPC
 Inventory system overhaul
 Combay System overhaul


Skyfall's Future

After concluding a poll with- surprising results, the players have made it clear that Skyfall is to become a 2D/3D hybrid. Making a 2D/3D hybrid from scratch, will definitely be an interesting experience! In terms of actual development, current systems shouldn't need to be overhauled or re-coded; they just need to be modified to work with a 3D environment.
